questions.question: How much blood is in a typical adult's body?
questions.fact: Men and women carry about the same share of their body weight as blood, 7 to 8%.

questions.question: How many bones are in an adult human skeleton?
questions.fact: Babies are born with around 270; some of them fuse together on the way to adulthood.

questions.question: How many nerve cells are in the human brain?
questions.fact: The whole adult brain weighs only about 1.2 to 1.4 kg, around 2% of the body's weight.

questions.question: How much air does an adult take in with one breath?
questions.fact: British rower Pete Reed is reported to have the largest lung capacity on record, 11.68 litres.

questions.question: How tall was Robert Wadlow, the tallest person ever recorded?
questions.fact: He weighed 199 kg when he died, aged 22.

questions.question: How long is a giraffe's tongue?
questions.fact: It's black, perhaps against sunburn, and grabs food from branches straight above when the giraffe tips its head back.

questions.question: How long was the longest blue whale ever scientifically measured?
questions.fact: A stranded blue whale's heart weighed 180 kg, the largest known heart of any animal.

questions.question: How long does an African bush elephant's pregnancy last?
questions.fact: It's the longest pregnancy of any mammal.

questions.question: How many legs does the leggiest millipede on record have?
questions.fact: It was the first millipede found with more than a thousand legs, and its name, Eumillipes, means 'true thousand feet'.

questions.question: What is the world's chicken population?
questions.fact: More than 50 billion are raised every year for meat and eggs.

questions.question: How old was the oldest Greenland shark ever dated?
questions.fact: Greenland sharks only reach maturity at around 150 years old.

questions.question: How tall is the Eiffel Tower?
questions.fact: It was the tallest human-made structure in the world for 41 years, until New York's Chrysler Building in 1930.

questions.question: How tall is the Statue of Liberty?
questions.definition: ground to torch tip, pedestal included
questions.fact: The copper statue itself is 46 metres to the torch; the pedestal and foundation make up the other half.

questions.question: How long is the Great Wall of China, counting all its sections?
questions.fact: The wall built under the Ming dynasty accounts for 8,850 km of it.

questions.question: How tall is the Burj Khalifa?
questions.fact: Almost a third of that is a spire with very little usable space: without it, the tower would stand 585 metres tall.

questions.question: What is the population of New York City?
questions.fact: An estimated 800 languages are spoken there, making it the most linguistically diverse city in the world.

questions.question: What is the area of Vatican City?
questions.fact: That makes it the world's smallest country, and with about 882 residents, the least populous too.

questions.question: How far away is the Moon?
questions.fact: It is spiralling away from Earth by about 3.8 cm a year.

questions.question: How long does sunlight take to reach Earth?
questions.fact: Getting out of the Sun is the slow part: light from its centre can take 10,000 to 170,000 years to reach the surface.

questions.question: How long does the International Space Station take to circle Earth once?
questions.fact: It travels at about 27,600 km/h, a little over 400 km up.

questions.question: How many people walked on the Moon during the Apollo program?
questions.fact: Nobody who landed there ever went back for a second time.

questions.question: How deep is the Challenger Deep, the deepest known point in the ocean?
questions.fact: Two men first reached the bottom in 1960, in the bathyscaphe Trieste.

questions.question: How tall is Angel Falls in Venezuela, the world's tallest waterfall?
questions.fact: Its biggest single plunge is 807 metres.

questions.question: How many flashes of lightning happen on Earth every second?
questions.fact: That adds up to nearly 1.4 billion flashes a year.

questions.question: How many trees are there on Earth?
questions.fact: That's 46% fewer than when farming began, 12,000 years ago.

questions.question: How fast does sound travel through air?
questions.fact: Through iron it goes almost 15 times faster.

questions.question: How much does a cubic metre of air weigh?
questions.fact: That is still about 800 times lighter than the same volume of water.

questions.question: How many elements are known to science?
questions.fact: Only the first 94 have been found occurring naturally on Earth.

questions.question: How many flowers does it take to make one kilogram of saffron?
questions.fact: Picking them by hand takes about forty hours.

questions.question: How much does a typical wheel of Parmigiano Reggiano weigh?
questions.fact: It takes a lot of milk: each 1,100-litre vat makes just two wheels.

questions.question: How hot must the oven be for a true Neapolitan pizza?
questions.fact: At that heat the pizza bakes in 60 to 90 seconds.

questions.question: What weight of tomatoes was thrown at Spain's La Tomatina festival?
questions.fact: It's thrown by up to 20,000 ticket holders, in a town of about 9,000 people.

questions.question: How long is a standard bank card?
questions.fact: It's the ID-1 card size, 85.60 by 53.98 mm, which most ID cards use too.

questions.question: How many passengers is an Airbus A380 certified to carry?
questions.fact: In the evacuation test, everyone got out in 78 seconds with half the exits blocked.

questions.question: How much water does an Olympic swimming pool hold?
questions.fact: The rules set no maximum depth, so as a unit of volume it's only ever approximate.

questions.question: How long is a marathon?
questions.fact: The distance was fixed in 1921, copied from the course of the 1908 London Olympics.

questions.question: How high is a basketball hoop?
questions.definition: to the top of the rim
questions.fact: The first baskets were peach baskets nailed to a gym balcony; metal hoops replaced them in 1906.

questions.question: How much gold is in an Olympic gold medal?
questions.fact: The rest of the medal is at least 92.5% silver.

questions.question: How long did the longest professional tennis match last?
questions.fact: John Isner beat Nicolas Mahut 70-68 in the fifth set, after 11 hours 5 minutes spread over three days.

source.title: Isner–Mahut match at the 2010 Wimbledon Championships

questions.question: How many keys does a modern piano have?
questions.fact: In Mozart's day pianos had five octaves; today's 88 keys span more than seven.

questions.question: How tall is the Mona Lisa?
questions.fact: It's painted on wood, not canvas: a poplar panel 77 by 53 cm.

questions.question: How many performances did The Phantom of the Opera give on Broadway?
questions.fact: It closed in 2023 as Broadway's longest-running show, by over 3,500 performances.

source.title: The Phantom of the Opera (1986 musical)

questions.question: How much beer does the Czech Republic drink per person each year?
questions.fact: No country drinks more; Austria comes second, at about 108 litres.

source.title: List of countries by beer consumption per capita

questions.question: How much tea does Turkey get through per person each year?
questions.fact: No country drinks more; Ireland comes second, at 2.36 kg.

source.title: List of countries by tea consumption per capita

questions.question: How many people can the world's biggest stadium hold?
questions.fact: North Korea's Rungrado 1st of May Stadium is next, at 113,281.

questions.question: What is the area of the Caspian Sea, the world's largest lake?
questions.fact: Lake Superior, the next largest, is only about a fifth of its size.

questions.question: How many hairs are on a typical brown-haired person's head?
questions.fact: It depends on colour: blond heads have the most, and redheads the fewest, about 90,000.

questions.question: How long is the record for holding your breath?
questions.definition: official freediving record, breathing only air first
questions.fact: Breathe pure oxygen beforehand and the record is over 29 minutes.

questions.question: How wide is an adult human eyeball?
questions.fact: At birth it is already 16 to 17 mm across, and it reaches full size by about age 12.

questions.question: How much does an adult human liver weigh?
questions.fact: It is the heaviest internal organ, and healthy adult livers range from about 0.6 to 1.9 kg.

questions.question: How much does an ostrich egg weigh?
questions.fact: That is over 20 times a chicken's egg, yet it's the smallest egg of any bird relative to the mother's size.

questions.question: How far does an Arctic tern fly in a year?
questions.definition: average for birds nesting in Greenland and Iceland
questions.fact: It flies from the Arctic to the Antarctic and back, the longest migration known in the animal kingdom.

questions.question: How deep can an emperor penguin dive?
questions.fact: That dive, by a penguin from the Auster colony in 1994, lasted 21.8 minutes.

questions.question: How fast can a hummingbird's heart beat?
questions.definition: fastest measured, in a blue-throated hummingbird
questions.fact: At night, in a torpor, a hummingbird's heart can slow to around 50 beats a minute.

questions.question: How fast can a cheetah run?
questions.fact: Its acceleration is the real weapon: from 0 to 97 km/h in under 3 seconds.

questions.question: How tall was the Great Pyramid of Giza when it was built?
questions.definition: before its outer casing was stripped
questions.fact: It was the tallest human-made structure in the world for more than 3,700 years.

questions.question: How tall is the Leaning Tower of Pisa?
questions.definition: from the ground, on the low side
questions.fact: Its top leans about 3.9 m out from the vertical.

questions.question: How long is the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau Bridge?
questions.definition: the whole crossing, link roads included
questions.fact: It is the longest sea crossing in the world; the main bridge alone runs 29.6 km.

questions.question: How far is Russia from the US across the Bering Strait?
questions.definition: mainland to mainland, at the narrowest
questions.fact: In the middle of the strait, Russia's Big Diomede and the US's Little Diomede islands are just 3.8 km apart.

questions.question: How many people live in Greenland?
questions.fact: That makes it the least densely populated country in the world.

questions.question: How long is the Trans-Siberian Railway?
questions.fact: It crosses eight time zones, a record for one railway line.

questions.question: How many people live in Antarctica in winter?
questions.fact: In summer the number swells to about 4,000.

questions.question: How much wider than Earth is the Sun?
questions.fact: The Sun holds 99.86% of all the mass in the Solar System.

questions.question: How tall is Olympus Mons, the giant volcano on Mars?
questions.fact: It covers an area about the size of Italy.

questions.question: How tall was the Saturn V rocket?
questions.definition: with the Apollo spacecraft on top
questions.fact: Its first stage alone was 42 m tall and 10 m wide.

questions.question: How long is a year on Mars?
questions.fact: So its seasons last nearly twice as long as Earth's.

questions.question: How much did the heaviest pumpkin ever grown weigh?
questions.fact: A giant pumpkin can put on up to 23 kg in a single day.

questions.question: How much can a single jackfruit weigh?
questions.fact: It is the largest fruit that grows on trees, up to 90 cm long.

questions.question: How many hot dogs did the record holder eat in 10 minutes?
questions.fact: In 2001 Takeru Kobayashi ate 50, nearly doubling the old record of 25.5.

questions.question: How long is a typical French baguette?
questions.fact: In the 19th century some French loaves were far longer, about 1.8 m.

questions.question: How much does a standard central bank gold bar weigh?
questions.definition: the Good Delivery bar that central banks trade
questions.fact: The largest gold bar ever made, cast in Dubai in 2024, weighed 300.12 kg.

questions.question: How far does the world's longest non-stop flight go?
questions.fact: It is scheduled to take nearly 19 hours.

questions.question: How long is the Ever Given, which blocked the Suez Canal?
questions.fact: Wedged across the canal in 2021, it blocked traffic for six days and backed up over two hundred ships.

questions.question: How tall is Mount Everest?
questions.fact: China and Nepal once argued over whether to count its snow cap, a difference of about 4 m.

questions.question: How tall is the tallest known living tree?
questions.fact: It has grown about 67 cm since it was first measured in 2006.

questions.question: How deep is Lake Baikal, the world's deepest lake?
questions.fact: It holds more water than all of North America's Great Lakes combined.

questions.question: How much can the fastest-growing bamboo grow in one day?
questions.fact: Most garden bamboos grow a more modest 3 to 10 cm a day in their growing season.

questions.question: How long is the Great Barrier Reef?
questions.fact: It is made up of over 2,900 separate reefs and 900 islands.

questions.question: How much does one litre of mercury weigh?
questions.fact: Mercury is so dense that old lighthouse lenses floated on a bath of it, which worked as a bearing.

questions.question: How fast does Earth spin at the equator?
questions.fact: It slows away from the equator: about 1,184 km/h at 45° latitude, and zero at the poles.

questions.question: How hot is it at the surface of Earth's inner core?
questions.fact: That is about as hot as the surface of the Sun.

questions.question: How hot is the hottest part of a candle flame?
questions.fact: The hottest spot is just above the dull blue part at the base; the bright yellow zone is cooler.

questions.question: How fast did Usain Bolt run at his top speed?
questions.fact: His average over the whole race, start included, was 37.58 km/h.

questions.question: How high is the men's high jump world record?
questions.fact: Javier Sotomayor set it in 1993, and nobody has beaten it since.

source.title: Men's high jump world record progression

questions.question: How fast is the fastest badminton smash recorded in a match?
questions.fact: The fastest tennis serve on record is only about 60% as fast.

questions.question: How much does the FIFA World Cup trophy weigh?
questions.fact: It is hollow: in solid gold it would weigh 70 to 80 kg, too heavy to lift.

questions.question: How much does a table tennis ball weigh?
questions.fact: The rules also say it must bounce 24 to 26 cm when dropped from 30.5 cm onto steel.

questions.question: How many soldiers are in China's Terracotta Army?
questions.fact: Every figure is life-sized, about 1.75 to 2 m tall, and the officers are the tallest.

questions.question: How tall is Michelangelo's David?
questions.fact: It was only measured exactly in 1998-99, and turned out taller than any source had said.

questions.question: How long is the Bayeux Tapestry?
questions.fact: It is only about 50 cm tall, and tells the story of the Norman conquest of England.

questions.question: How tall are the letters of the Hollywood Sign?
questions.fact: The original 1923 sign read HOLLYWOODLAND, in letters about 15 m tall, and was meant to last only a year and a half.

questions.question: How many people came to the Woodstock festival in 1969?
questions.fact: The organisers had told the town to expect no more than 50,000.

questions.question: How long is the Nile?
questions.fact: Some scientists argue the Amazon is longer: it depends on where you say each river starts and ends.

source.title: List of river systems by length

questions.question: How many trips are taken on the Shanghai Metro each year?
questions.fact: No metro system in the world carries more passengers.
